title: Caller + Social Media Manager
description:
Insurance, Mortgage & Business Lending



**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term

**Hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

**Company:** Baz State Insurance, Mortgage & Lending

**Pay:** $450/month base + $50 bonus per closed deal



---



## About Us



Baz State Insurance, Mortgage & Lending is a U.S.-based financial services company in California. We help clients with auto insurance, home insurance, business insurance, home loans, and business funding.



We are growing fast and use GoHighLevel (GHL) as our CRM.



This is a dual role. You must handle both social media and lead calling.



If you only want to do social media, do not apply.

If you do not want to make calls, do not apply.



---



## Part 1 — Social Media



You will manage and create weekly content for our business social media accounts.



### Weekly Content Requirement



* 5 image posts per week

* 3 short videos per week

* Captions with clear calls-to-action

* Post on Instagram,
, TikTok, and LinkedIn

* Respond to comments and DMs within 1 hour

* Track weekly reach, engagement, and leads generated



### Tools



* Canva

* CapCut

* Meta Business Suite

* GoHighLevel



---



## Part 2 — Lead Calling



You will call, qualify, and follow up with leads using GoHighLevel.



### Daily Calling Requirement



* Up to 300 calls per day using GoHighLevel power dialer

* Call inbound leads within 5 minutes of form submission

* Follow provided scripts

* Qualify leads for insurance, mortgage, or business loans

* Book appointments

* Confirm appointments

* Log every call, note, and outcome in GHL CRM

* Follow up until the lead is closed or disqualified



This is a high-volume calling role. Do not apply if you are not comfortable making a large number of calls every day.



---



## You Are a Fit If



* You have called U.S.-based customers before

* You are comfortable with high-volume daily calling

* You have managed social media for a real business, not only personal accounts

* Your English is clear, confident, and professional on the phone

* You know Canva, CapCut, and Meta Business Suite basics

* You have used a CRM before

* You are reliable and show up on time every day

* You can follow scripts, systems, and instructions

* You are results-focused, not task-focused



---



## Bonus Points



* GoHighLevel experience

* Insurance, mortgage, real estate, finance, or lending experience

* Appointment-setting experience

* Power dialer experience

* Experience calling U.S.-based leads



---



## What We Measure



| Image posts per week -5 minimum 

| Short videos per week- 3 minimum

| Daily calls - Up to 300/day

| Lead response time - Under 5 minutes 

| Leads contacted - 40%+ of all leads 

| Appointments set - 20%+ of contacted leads

| Appointment show rate - 70%+ 



---



## Compensation



**Base Pay:** $350/month

**Bonus:** $50 per closed deal

**Bonus Cap:** No cap



A closed deal means:



* Bound insurance policy

* Funded mortgage loan

* Funded business loan

* Signed application that results in a funded or bound deal within 30 days



### Example Earnings



* 5 closed deals = $600/month

* 10 closed deals = $850/month

* 15 closed deals = $1,100/month



Salary review after 60 days based on:



* Attendance

* Content quality

* Call volume

* CRM accuracy

* Appointments booked

* Closed deals generated



Higher pay is available only after performance is proven.



---



## To Apply



Complete all steps below. If you miss any step, your application will be ignored.



1. Write **“BAZ STATE READY”** at the top of your message

2. Send your resume

3. Send links to 2–3 business social media accounts you have managed

4. Send a 60-second Loom video or voice message introducing yourself

5. Explain your U.S. calling experience

6. Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

7. Confirm you can make up to 300 calls per day



Applications missing any required item will not be reviewed.

title: Company Accountant
description:
We are an Australian automotive and trade services business using Odoo as our ERP. This role suits an accountant who enjoys autonomy and is comfortable owning a finance function independently — managing AP, AR, payroll, inventory, BAS, month-end close, and reporting for the business.



About the Role

This is a full function ownership role. You will be the sole finance resource for the business — managing everything from daily transactional processing through to month-end close, inventory reconciliation, payroll, BAS compliance, and management reporting. You will have direct access to the business operations lead for approvals and escalations.



The right person has done this before, is comfortable working independently, and does not need a team around them to deliver clean, reliable numbers.



Key Responsibilities

• Own the full month-end close in Odoo — journals, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and balance sheet reconciliations

• Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable — invoice processing, cash application, collections, and supplier reconciliations

• Reconcile bank accounts daily in Odoo, independent of the payments you process

• Perform monthly inventory reconciliation — reconcile the inventory subledger to the GL and investigate all stock variances

• Process payroll for all employees in Rippling — prepare, reconcile, and submit for written approval before any funding

• Prepare BAS workpapers and coordinate with the external accountant for lodgement

• Meet all Australian statutory obligations — PAYG withholding, superannuation, and payroll tax on time

• Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement with variance commentary for management

• Assist management with weekly cash flow forecasting and working capital monitoring

• Maintain Odoo chart of accounts integrity and document all finance processes as SOPs



What We Are Looking For

• Degree in Accounting or Finance — CPA or equivalent preferred

• Minimum 4 years accounting experience with at least 2 years owning a finance function end-to-end

• Strong, hands-on Odoo experience across finance modules — able to work independently without system support

• Experience in a business holding physical inventory — essential

• Experience with inventory reconciliation and stock management in Odoo or a comparable ERP — essential

• Solid knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, PAYG withholding, and payroll tax obligations

• Experience with Rippling payroll or an equivalent cloud payroll platform

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — reconciliation workpapers and financial reporting

• Strong written English — able to report clearly to Australian management

• Self-directed and reliable — genuinely comfortable as the sole finance resource



What We Offer

• Full ownership of a finance function — genuine responsibility, not a support role

• Stable, long-term contractor engagement

• Direct access to the business operations lead and group CFO

• A small, focused business where your work makes an immediate and visible difference



This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of a finance function and work directly with business leaders in a growing Australian trade services business.



Mandatory Screening Questions

Answer all questions in your application. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Screening Question Required

How many years of hands-on Odoo experience do you have? 3+ years

Have you owned a month-end close process end-to-end without supervision? Yes

Have you worked in a business that holds physical inventory? Yes

Have you performed inventory reconciliation in Odoo or a similar ERP? Yes

Have you prepared Australian BAS workpapers for external lodgement? Yes

Have you processed payroll using Rippling or a similar cloud payroll system? Yes

Are you comfortable as the sole finance resource for a business? Yes

Do you hold an accounting degree or equivalent qualification? Yes



To apply: submit your CV and answers to all eight screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will receive a full position description prior to interview. 



Remuneration dependent on experience and qualification.

title: SALES CLOSER
description:

• Remote or on-site work setup (as applicable)

position overview

title: LinkedIn Outreach + CRM Coordinator for Premium Video Production Agency
description:
Hi! I'm David, founder of Puggers Video Production, a boutique cinematic video studio in Vancouver, Canada.

We make brand films for marketing teams at premium B2B companies. We've been growing for 3 years and I'm finally ready to bring on a long-term VA to help me scale our outbound sales.



This role starts at 20 hours per week, part-time. If you crush it in the first 60-90 days and the work grows with results, this scales to a full-time long-term role at higher pay.



I'm looking for someone reliable I can work with for years, not a short project.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY:



• Run my LinkedIn outreach: send connection requests and personalized messages to marketing directors at companies I target

• Research and qualify new leads in LinkedIn Sales Navigator (I'll give you my exact ICP criteria)

• Organize and maintain our CRM in Notion (track every conversation, last contact date, next action)

• Coordinate discovery call logistics (
 bookings, confirmations, pre-call prep notes for David)

• Send a Monday morning brief: today's three priorities for me

• Sunday wrap-up: what got done that week, what's overdue, what's at risk



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF:



• 3+ years of real experience in sales support, LinkedIn outreach, or CRM management

• C1 or C2 English (you'll be writing messages to native English speakers in Canada)

• You've used Notion before, or you're confident you can learn it fast

• You've used LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or you're confident you can learn it fast

• You're proactive: you flag things instead of waiting for instructions

• You can join a 30-minute weekly sync at 7am Vancouver time (10pm Philippines time)



COMPENSATION:



$
USD per month for 20 hours per week (depending on experience)

Paid weekly via Wise (or let me know your prefered payment method).



90-day review with potential to scale to 40 hours/week and higher pay if results are strong



Long-term role, not a short project



HOW WE'LL START:



Paid trial first. $75 fixed-price exercise: research 5 leads, qualify them against our ICP, write personalized outreach, and organize everything in our Notion CRM. 3-day delivery. Full brief and assets sent to selected candidates after interviews. If the trial goes well, we move straight to a recurring weekly contract.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THESE TWO QUESTIONS IN YOUR RESPONSE:



Generic copy-paste responses will be ignored.



What's the most complex CRM workflow you've built or managed? Tell me what changed for the business after you built it.



Tell me about one time you had to qualify a lead and d
 whether to pursue them or pass. What was your reasoning?



Looking forward to meeting you!

David

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Personal Assistant (in-person / requires travel)
description:
My name is Scott Watkins and I am the owner of a small software development company.  And while we are based in the United States, most of our workforce is in the Philippines.



Actually, our company was one of the first to use the OnlineJobs.ph platform, and John (owner of OnlineJobs) was the one who actually sold us on using the platform.  Today, our small company hires all our staff solely from OnlineJobs.Ph



Here is a brief interview from OnlineJobs showcasing our company: 

==================================



JOB DESRIPTION



So, my wife (Filipina) and I regularly travel to the Philippines to visit her family and collaborate with our VAs/Staff.



We will be arriving in the Philippines this coming late August, and will stay through the first three weeks of September.



I am looking to hire someone who can assist me in researching and planning my itinerary before we arrive (so will technically be my VA before arriving).  They will then meet us upon arrival and will act as my Personal Assistant for the duration of our stay.  Then after we leave, they will follow-up with closing out and finishing any unfinished business left there.



The job will pay an hourly rate based on the number of hours available and worked prior to our arrival .. then will pay a flat rate for the duration of our stay there, followed by an indeterminate amount after we leave based on the work required.



For the most part, while there, the PA will go wherever I go and spend everyday with me.  They will be given time each day for themselves of-course, but will need to be flexible depending on circumstances.  We will be bringing our children, so there will also be some days dedicated to spending time with the family (e.g. Enchanted Kingdom, etc). There will be some days that my wife and I may plan to leave the kids behind and visit certain places as well (e.g. Floating Restaurant in Bohol, etc).  Other times, my wife may wish to go off into the province and visit her relatives (which I definitely do not like doing), so I may d
 to travel by myself to exotic locations around the Philippines, play golf, or just hit up the local malls.  Due to the time difference, I also tend to be a night owl there, and enjoy hitting up clubs/bars/KTVs for some nightly entertainment.



There are too many things to list out, but regardless of where we go and what I do, the PA's job will be to always make sure to be by my side, ensure that I make it safely to whatever destination we go, ensure I have a fun and enjoyable time, and ensure I always return home safely.  This may include running small errands (e.g. getting food/medicine) and occasionally traveling by themselves (e.g. meeting a venue owner to finalize details). But 95% of the time they will be at my side.



There are other things that may be involved (e.g. lodging arrangements and travel accommodations) that will also be discussed in the interview.



But I will cover all expenses for everything; including food, accommodations, travel, and personal expenses.  Including also the salary, which will be discussed and d
 based on skills, experience, and meeting requirements.



Previous experience is not necessary. The main things that matter the most are:

- Understand/Speak English for long periods of time

- Honesty and Loyalty to me

- Willing to go where I want to go, do what I want to do, and ensure I enjoy myself going/doing it

- A consistently positive attitude and eager to please

- An adventurous spirit and willing to go places and do things never done before

- Being flexible and adaptable as things change (as they always do in the Philippines)

- Willing to put in the work and effort to ensure we have a great and smooth vacation



People who are naturally open and conversational will also have a great advantage (e.g. Westerners love to socialize)



All are welcome to apply no matter the location, gender, age, religion, or marital status.  I have hired them all in previous trips.  However, in my previous experience, Younger PAs tend to be more adventurous, Filipinas tend to speak better English, and married individuals tend to be more 'intuitive' with my and my family needs. Additionally, my wife is from Davao, so Bisaya/Cebuano will give you an advantage with her, though not required for me. - But I am open to considering any and all who wish to apply.



If you think you might enjoy traveling the country, accompanying one of the world's greatest bosses, and visiting some of the nicest places the Philippines has to offer, all at my expense ... then I invite you to click on the link and fill out our short application form here: 







You may also
 me at 
 - be sure to include your OnlineJobs profile link, FB, and WhatsApp.



Though filling out the online application will get better response times.



I look forward to hearing from you. 



//Scott Watkins

title: SEO & AEO Specialist
description:
*** DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE AN AGENCY *** 



About EasyMate

EasyMate.ai helps small and medium-sized businesses use AI to automate customer-facing operations, from capturing leads to answering questions, following up, supporting customers, and growing revenue.

EasyMate is built for non-technical business owners who do not have large teams, expensive software systems, or technical expertise. EasyMate configures the right AI assistants and solutions for SMB owners based on their business problems. They don't have to learn AI.



The Role

We're looking for an SEO & AEO Specialist who lives at the intersection of traditional search and AI answer engines. This isn't a "write blogs and hope for the best" role. You'll own our entire organic visibility strategy — from technical SEO to making sure EasyMate gets cited when someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews about AI-powered coaching tools.

AEO is still new territory. We want someone who's actively thinking about it, experimenting with it, and can build our playbook — not someone who learned about it in a webinar last week.



What You'll Own

- Organic Search (SEO)

- Build and execute our keyword and topical authority strategy from the ground up

- Conduct technical SEO audits and work with our dev team to implement fixes (Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, site architecture)

- Develop a hub-and-spoke content architecture that establishes EasyMate as the definitive resource for AI-powered coaching tools

- Build and track our backlink strategy — earned, not bought



AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

- Optimize content to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews

- Apply structured content frameworks (answer-first formatting, EAV coverage, brand authority statements) to maximize AI citation rates

- Monitor EasyMate's visibility across AI platforms and identify gaps

- Detect and eliminate LLM deprioritization signals (thin content, unedited AI patterns, missing E-E-A-T signals) across our content library



Content Strategy & Production

- Develop a content calendar aligned to search intent, competitive gaps, and topical authority building

- Write or direct the writing of long-form blog content (2,000+ words) that earns both search rankings and AI citations

- Ensure every piece of content includes verifiable claims, data points, and definitive positioning — the kind of content LLMs actually cite

- Maintain content freshness across the entire library (not just new posts)

- Analytics & Reporting

- Set up and own our SEO/AEO reporting stack

- Track rankings, organic traffic, AI citation frequency, and content ROI

- Translate data into clear recommendations, not just dashboards



What We're Looking For

Must-haves

- 3–5 years of SEO experience with a track record of measurable organic growth

- Demonstrated understanding of AEO — you know what makes content get cited by AI systems and can articulate it clearly

- Strong grasp of semantic SEO, topical authority building, and content architecture (not just keyword stuffing)

- Hands-on experience with technical SEO: schema markup, structured data, Core Web Vitals, crawl optimization

- Ability to write — or edit and direct — high-quality long-form content

- Fluency with tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, and Screaming Frog

- Schedule: Based in Jakarta with reliable high-speed internet. You must be comfortable with a 3 to 4-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time (typical either evening/night hours in Jakarta).

- Grit: You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where you are expected to ship multiple experiments weekly.



Nice-to-haves

- Experience in B2B SaaS or AI/tech categories

- Familiarity with frameworks like Holistic SEO (Koray Tugberk Gubur) or AEO strategy (Evan Bailyn / First Page Sage)

- Experience building an SEO function from scratch at an early-stage startup

- Basic understanding of how LLMs parse and cite web content



Who thrives here

- You can move fast without waiting for a perfect brief

- You think in systems, not one-off tasks

- You're genuinely curious about where search is going — and you have opinions about it

- You're comfortable being the only person owning this function for now



Why Join EasyMate

- Ground-floor opportunity to define the SEO/AEO playbook for an emerging AI product category

- Direct impact — your work will be one of our primary growth levers

- Async-friendly, remote team

- Work on a product that's genuinely novel (and fun to explain)

- Freedom: 100% remote work with a high-trust, results-only culture.

This role is not experimental. It is execution-driven.



You will design, deploy, and optimize enterprise-grade AI workflows that integrate Claude and ClawdBot into real business systems, including CRM, ticketing, cybersecurity operations, marketing automation, compliance documentation, reporting, and internal knowledge management.



The objective is measurable business impact, not surface-level automation.

• Integrate ClawdBot into internal systems and external client-facing workflows

• Build secure API integrations between Claude and our CRM, PSA, ERP, and BI systems

• Develop prompt engineering frameworks aligned with compliance and governance requirements

• Implement AI guardrails, logging, and role-based access controls

• Design automation workflows using tools such as n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, or custom scripts

• Create executive dashboards for AI utilization and ROI measurement

• Ensure all AI deployments align with cybersecurity and regulatory standards



Required Experience:

• Hands-on experience integrating Claude (Anthropic API) in production environments

• Experience deploying chatbot frameworks such as ClawdBot or similar LLM-based agents

• Strong API integration experience (REST, JSON, webhooks)

• Experience with workflow automation platforms

• Familiarity with prompt engineering methodologies

• Knowledge of AI governance, model limitations, and risk controls

• Experience working with enterprise data systems



Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience integrating AI into cybersecurity or compliance-driven environments

• Experience with Microsoft ecosystem tools (Power BI, Power Apps, Copilot)

• Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles

• Experience deploying AI in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, government)

• Python, Node.js, or similar scripting capability





Compensation:

• Competitive base salary

• Performance-based bonus tied to measurable AI impact

• Flexible engagement options (full-time, contract, hybrid)



Apply here and send resume to:

title: Ecommerce VA —  Photoshop Image QA + Listings Management
description:
We’re building a wallpaper and fabric online store. We need a careful, reliable VA to help manage our product pipeline and keep our catalog clean, organized, and accurate.



Most of this role is ecommerce operations: managing product assets, updating trackers, preparing listings, uploading approved files, and keeping the workflow moving. A smaller but important part of the role involves checking design files and mockups in Photoshop before they move forward.



We will train you on our exact workflow, but you must already be comfortable using Adobe Photoshop. Photoshop is required because some tasks involve opening design files, checking image details, placing artwork into mockups, and flagging visual issues.



What you’ll do:



Manage the product pipeline from design files to live Shopify listings

Keep trackers updated so we know what is ready, blocked, or needs review

Organize files and make sure assets are named and stored correctly

Upload approved assets into our Digital Asset Manager

Build and update Shopify product listings

Open design files in Photoshop and check basic file setup, color profile, dimensions, and resolution

Review wallpaper/fabric repeat proofs for visible seams, gaps, alignment problems, or obvious errors

Place designs into simple product mockups using our templates

Do light color cleanup or adjustment using exact instructions and provided tools

Flag issues clearly with notes and screenshots



Success looks like:



Product listings go live accurate and on time

Files are organized and easy to find

Trackers are always up to date

Visual mistakes are caught before products go live

Notes are clear enough that another person can understand the issue without asking follow-up questions



Required:



Strong attention to detail

Comfortable following written checklists

Reliable with repetitive, detail-heavy work

Able to learn new tools and work independently

Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop

Comfortable opening PSD files, using layers, checking image details, placing artwork into mockups, and exporting assets



Nice to have:



Shopify listing experience

Product image editing experience

Ecommerce catalog management experience

Wallpaper, fabric, textile, pattern, or print production experience



Important:



This is not a design role and you will not be creating artwork from scratch. It is a detail-heavy ecommerce operations role with some Photoshop-based image QA. We can train you on our wallpaper/fabric workflow, but we cannot train basic Photoshop skills from scratch.



To apply:



In your subject line, answer this: What version of Photoshop do you use?



Then send:



One paragraph about your ecommerce, Shopify, or catalog management experience

One paragraph about your Photoshop experience

Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

A speed test result

Your CV

A short answer to this question: Tell us about a time you caught a mistake others missed.

A short answer to this question: Have you ever checked a product image, mockup, repeating pattern, textile file, or wallpaper design? If yes, describe what you checked.

title: Part-Time PR + Podcast Outreach Assistant
description:
**Part-Time PR + Podcast Outreach Assistant**



I’m hiring a part-time PR + podcast outreach assistant to help grow media visibility for a U.S.-based author, speaker, and behavior change expert.



This is a remote role for someone who is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and excellent at online research and written English.



The main goal of this role is to help book podcast interviews, media opportunities, and visibility placements that introduce more people to my work.



You do not need to be a PR expert, but you do need to be very good at researching, following instructions, keeping a tracker updated, personalizing outreach, and moving consistently without being chased.



**About the brand**



Allie Casazza is a bestselling author, speaker, and behavior change expert who helps women stop starting over and become someone who follows through using identity rewiring, subconscious reprogramming, and nervous system-based tools.



The core media angle we are building around is:



Why smart, capable women keep starting over, and how to stop.



You’ll be helping us find and pitch podcasts, media outlets, journalists, and guest opportunities that align with this message.



**Responsibilities**



* Research podcasts, media outlets, journalists, and guest opportunities

* Find accurate contact
s, booking forms, or submission links

* Personalize and send podcast/media pitches using provided templates

* Track all outreach in Notion or Google Sheets

* Send follow-ups after 7 days

* Monitor replies and flag warm opportunities

* Keep the outreach tracker clean and updated

* Send a weekly report with pitches sent, follow-ups sent, replies, and booked opportunities

* Help build and maintain a list of strong-fit media targets



**Weekly expectations**



This role will start at approximately **10 hours per week**.



Each week, the goal will be:



* 10-15 podcast/media pitches sent

* 10-15 new strong-fit targets added to the tracker

* Follow-ups sent on time

* Tracker fully updated

* Weekly report sent every Friday



**You’ll be given**



* Pitch templates

* Media kit

* Podcast/media angles

* Target categories

* Outreach tracker

* Clear weekly expectations

* Examples of the kind of shows/outlets we want to be featured on



**Ideal candidate**



You are a great fit if you:



* Have strong written English

* Are highly organized and detail-oriented

* Are comfortable doing online research

* Can personalize a message without sounding fake, robotic, or overly formal

* Can follow a repeatable system

* Are reliable with deadlines

* Communicate clearly

* Are comfortable using Google Sheets, Notion, Gmail, and basic online tools

* Can work independently and ask smart questions when needed

* Have experience with podcast pitching, PR outreach, media research, influencer outreach, or lead generation



**You are not a fit if you:**



* Need constant reminders to complete tasks

* Send generic copy/paste messages without personalizing

* Struggle with written English

* Do not keep trackers updated

* Are uncomfortable doing repetitive outreach

* Miss details in instructions



**Starting schedule**



10 hours/week for the first 30 days, with the possibility of increasing if it’s a good fit.



**Starting rate**



$6-$8/hour depending on experience.



**To apply, please send:**



1. A few sentences about your experience with outreach, research, podcasts, PR, or admin support

2. Your hourly rate

3. Your availability

4. Any relevant tools you’ve used, like Google Sheets, Notion, Gmail, podcast directories, media databases, etc.

5. A sample of a short outreach
 you’ve written, if you have one

6. The word BECOMING in your subject line so I know you read this carefully



**Small test task**



Please also include 2 podcasts you think would be a good fit for Allie Casazza and explain why in 1-2 sentences each.

title: Carrier Sales Representative
description:

As our network continues to expand, we’re looking for a Carrier Sales Representative to help us build strong, long-term relationships with carriers and support clean, on-time freight execution. If you enjoy structured outbound work, building partnerships, and working in a fast-paced logistics environment this role offers clear expectations, measurable growth, and career advancement.

s to carrier lists to support load coverage

• Highly organized, tech savvy, and able to manage multiple spreadsheets and group chats

• Communicate professionally via phone, chat, and

If you’re looking for a role where effort is recognized and growth is tied to output, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Owner Operator Dispatch Coordinator
description:
Gomez Haulers (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a growing asset-based trucking operation and owner-operator program focused on keeping freight moving safely, efficiently, and profitably. We support independent owner-operators running under the Gomez Haulers MC through dedicated contract freight, strategic dispatching, compliance oversight, and operational support.



This is not a call center position. This is a real trucking operations role where you will work directly with drivers, dispatchers, and operations leadership to ensure loads move successfully from assignment to delivery while maintaining compliance, documentation accuracy, and strong driver support.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational point of contact for a group of owner-operators operating under the Gomez Haulers network. You will manage route assignments, driver communication, documentation, compliance tracking, load monitoring, and settlement coordination while ensuring every driver has the support needed to operate successfully.



This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced transportation operations, communicates effectively with drivers, stays organized under pressure, and takes ownership of problems before they become operational disruptions



What You’ll Be Doing



Dispatch & Load Management

• Assign dedicated routes and scheduled loads based on driver availability, location, and equipment.

• Manage daily route boards and confirm driver assignments, departure times, and delivery schedules.

• Coordinate return loads, backhauls, and spot market opportunities when applicable.

• Monitor active loads in real time through tracking platforms and GPS visibility tools.

• Communicate route changes, delays, weather impacts, and operational updates to drivers promptly.

• Ensure all assigned loads have confirmed driver, trailer, and departure information before dispatch.



Driver Communication & Support

• Serve as the primary point of contact for owner-operators throughout their workday.

• Maintain consistent communication through phone, messaging platforms, and operational systems.

• Conduct daily check-ins with active drivers to confirm schedules, progress, and operational concerns.

• Coordinate with facilities, customers, and internal departments to resolve issues impacting deliveries.

• Escalate a
, breakdowns, service failures, delays, and compliance concerns immediately.



Documentation & Administrative Oversight

• Review and process Bills of Lading (BOLs), Proofs of Delivery (PODs), rate confirmations, and supporting documentation.

• Ensure delivery documents are uploaded accurately and within required deadlines.

• Maintain driver qualification records, insurance documentation, and compliance files.

• Track fuel receipts, toll records, scale tickets, and other required operational paperwork.

• Prepare and submit weekly settlement and operational reports.



Compliance & Safety Monitoring

• Monitor driver Hours of Service (HOS) and ELD activity.

• Identify and address potential compliance violations before they occur.

• Track expiration dates for medical cards, licenses, inspections, drug testing requirements, and qualification files.

• Coordinate annual inspections and required compliance documentation.

• Report safety i
 and compliance concerns to leadership immediately.



Billing & Settlement Support

• Coordinate with billing teams to ensure completed loads are invoiced accurately and on time.

• Verify settlement deductions, advances, fuel charges, and related driver expenses.

• Reconcile completed loads against settlement records and identify discrepancies.

• Assist drivers with settlement questions and escalate complex issues when necessary.



Operational Excellence

• Maintain accurate information across company systems and operational platforms.

• Identify recurring operational issues and recommend process improvements.

• Provide daily and weekly operational updates to management.

• Take ownership of assigned drivers and loads from dispatch through completion.



Who We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in trucking dispatch, freight brokerage, logistics coordination, or transportation operations.

• Strong understanding of trucking terminology including BOLs, PODs, ELDs, HOS, DOT, MC numbers, and rate confirmations.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple drivers, loads, and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced environment where delays, breakdowns, and operational changes occur daily.

• Self-directed, accountable, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.

• Reliable home office setup with stable internet and backup solutions.

• Ability to work U.S. Central Time business hours consistently.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Samsara, DAT, Truckstop, MONARC, LoadStop, McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar transportation platforms.

• Experience supporting owner-operators or independent contractors.

• Knowledge of dedicated contract freight operations.

• Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire with a US-Based Transportation Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Mon - Fri 8 AM - 5 PM with flexibility for weekend coverage CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Camera-on Zoom environment during shifts

• Hubstaff time tracking may be required



What You'll Get

• $6.00/hour. Paid consistently biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Long-term, stable position supporting a growing owner-operator division. (This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.)

• Opportunity to develop dispatch, compliance, and fleet management expertise

• Advancement opportunities as the owner-operator program expands



Growth Path

Top performers may advance into:

• Senior Dispatch Coordinator ($7-$8/hr)

• Dispatch Team Lead ($8-$9/hr)

• Owner-Operator Operations Coordinator ($9-$10/hr)



As the owner-operator fleet grows, additional leadership and operational opportunities will become available for individuals who demonstrate ownership, reliability, and strong operational execution.



Who Thrives Here

• Dispatchers who enjoy solving operational problems in real time.

• Logistics professionals who take ownership instead of waiting for direction.

• Individuals who communicate proactively and build strong driver relationships.

• Tea
mbers who can balance urgency, compliance, customer service, and operational execution simultaneously.

• Operators who want long-term growth within a rapidly expanding trucking organization.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics, and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

title: Content Designer + Video Editor
description:
Social Content Designer & Video Editor 



BigMouth Inc.   |   Full-Time · Remote ·  

Reports to: BigMouth Brand Marketing Manager 



BigMouth makes the loud, the weird, and the joyful — products built to stop scrolls and make people laugh. Our hashtag is #MakeFunLouder. We're rebuilding our Instagram and
 presence and we need a visual creative who can take what exists — product photography, raw footage, lifestyle imagery — and turn it into content that performs. 



This is a hands-on execution role. You won't be shooting original content; you'll be working from a library of raw assets and making them come alive. Direction and copy come from the Brand Marketing Manager. Your job is to execute that direction at a high visual standard, on time, every time — and to feed our TikTok agency clean raw assets so their content stays on-brand. 



What You Will Do 



Instagram Reels: Edit raw footage and product video into short-form content with strong pacing, motion, and platform-correct formatting. 



Graphics & carousels: Product-forward, brand-consistent, scroll-stopping statics and carousels for Instagram and
. 



GIFs & motion graphics: Bring still product imagery to life with animation and motion. 



Photo editing: Color-correct, retouch, clean backgrounds, and prep raw product photography so it looks intentional — not pulled straight off a drive. 



Agency asset feed: Supply the TikTok agency with clean, organized raw assets and brand context. 



Sales & display support: Execute deck layouts, retail banners, and Toy Fair display assets briefed by the Brand Marketing Manager. 



Pinterest adaptation: Resize and reformat assets for Pinterest's format and audience. 



Who You Are 



Experience: 3–5 years of social content design and video editing, with a portfolio of platform-native work — not general graphic design. 



Video editing: Expert in Premiere, CapCut, or equivalent. You create 
ntum and visual interest from raw or still footage without relying on live UGC. 



Motion: After Effects, Photoshop, or equivalent. Strong GIF and animation skills. 



Instagram fluency: You understand aspect ratios, hook frames, pacing, audio timing, and why a Reel underperforms. 



Photo skills: Lightroom / Camera Raw to process RAW product files; Photoshop for retouching and background cleanup. 



Design: Photoshop and Illustrator for clean, brand-consistent statics that don't need a second designer to polish. 



Brand voice: You naturally get humor-forward brands. You're funny without trying to be. 



AI fluency: You use AI tools to accelerate production, generate variations, and QC your own work. 



Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a professional setup, and hardware that runs editing software smoothly. Good written English to receive and confirm briefs. 



This Is Not the Right Role If 



Your portfolio is only print or static design — we need someone who lives in video and motion 



You need a live shoot to make compelling content — our asset library is your raw material 



You submit work for feedback before reviewing it against the brief yourself 



Platform specs and algorithm behavior are things you Google rather than already know 



Your First 30 Days 



First rounds of META content produced and published with minimal revision cycles 



The Brand Marketing Manager is spending less time on content execution because you've got it 



Your content is unmistakably BigMouth 



Applications without a portfolio link and the written answers will not be reviewed. Show us how you think, not just what you've made. 



 



TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY 



•  Portfolio link with at least 3 Reels / short-form edits and 2 static or motion graphic pieces (no portfolio = not reviewed). 



•  In 3–4 sentences: How do you create engaging, high-energy content when you DON'T have live footage to work with — only existing product shots and raw clips? Walk us through your approach. 



•  Pick one item from our Instagram or website and tell us, in 2–3 sentences, how you'd turn it into a Reel that performs.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant – Global Capital Origination, Institutional Outreach & Multi-Vertical Deal Sourcing



Role overview



This role runs structured global outbound systems across capital markets, infrastructure, energy, AI governance, tax structuring, and special situations. The objective is direct origination of counterparties, transactions, and advisory mandates through high-volume, signal-based outreach and institutional targeting.



The function is execution-heavy, systems-driven, and pipeline-focused across multiple parallel verticals.



Core mandates



1. Global private credit and capital need origination

    Identify companies globally with revenue above 50m showing refinancing pressure, liquidity stress, covenant strain, operational disruption, or acquisition intent. Build and maintain live pipelines of capital demand and initiate direct outreach for financing, restructuring, or structured solutions.

2. EU AI Act compliance and governance demand

    Target enterprises requiring AI governance frameworks, regulatory assessment, and compliance readiness under EU AI Act requirements. Focus on regulated industries and AI-adopting corporates with compliance exposure.

3. UK energy efficiency and Warm Homes deployment (UK and Scotland only)

    Source and contact delivery partners for energy efficiency programs. Engage homeowners, property holders, and churches for Warm Homes-related installations and upgrades. Build localised partner and end-user pipelines.

4. Institutional tax structuring and fund advisory demand (global)

    Engage general partners, pension funds, private credit firms, and institutional allocators requiring cross-border tax structuring, fund optimisation, and investment vehicle advisory.

5. AI and technology workforce demand generation

    Target AI, software, and deep tech firms globally requiring recruitment scale, workforce expansion, and specialised talent sourcing.

6. Distressed asset and acquisition pipeline mapping

    Identify companies globally with acquisition potential, restructuring signals, distressed balance sheets, or strategic divestment indicators. Build structured lists for deal origination and outreach.

7. Legal, M&A advisory, and intermediary network development

    Engage law firms, corporate finance advisers, and M&A boutiques globally to surface transactions requiring financing, co-investment, or structured capital placement.

8. Private credit partnership and co-investment intelligence

    Engage private credit firms globally to map investment appetite, sector focus, ticket sizes, and structuring preferences. Build co-investment and syndication pipelines.

9. Banking and institutional credit exposure mapping

    Engage banks and financial institutions to identify non-performing loan portfolios, credit exposures, and asset sale opportunities.



Core execution requirements



Use Apollo AI to source and segment global companies based on financial stress signals, size thresholds, sector exposure, and transaction relevance.



Operate Instantly and Flag to execute high-volume outbound campaigns across multiple domains with strict deliverability control.



Set up and maintain domain infrastructure, inbox creation, and warm-up cycles to sustain large-scale outbound activity without degradation.



Design and manage multi-vertical CRM pipelines with strict segmentation, tracking, and reporting across all outreach streams.



Continuously refine targeting models based on response data, conversion outcomes, and transaction flow.



Ensure global coverage across all verticals, with UK and Scotland-only execution for energy efficiency and housing programs.



Required capability profile



High-volume outbound execution experience in B2B environments with measurable pipeline generation.



Hands-on expertise with Apollo or equivalent data intelligence platforms.



Strong command of cold
 infrastructure including domain strategy, warm-up systems, and deliverability control.



Ability to operate multiple concurrent pipelines without loss of precision or segmentation integrity.



Strong organisational discipline with structured tracking of outreach, responses, and deal progression.



Preferred background



Private credit, investment banking, structured finance, consulting, distressed debt, or high-performance outbound environments.



Exposure to infrastructure, energy systems, AI regulation, or institutional capital markets.



Performance expectation



Sustained global pipeline creation across multiple capital, advisory, and transactional verticals, converting outbound intelligence into qualified counterparties, mandates, and live deal flow across institutional markets.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
ABOUT VAMOSWATU

(
)



VamosWatu is a talent partner for US-based Seed and Series A startups. We help founders build lean, high-performing in-house tech teams by owning the entire talent function: sourcing, vetting, payroll, compliance, and office operations. We do not flood inboxes with CVs. We find the RIGHT engineers, vet them for skill and culture fit, and embed them directly into our customers' organizations.



Everyone we place works full-time, is integrated with the customer, and is supported by VamosWatu's startup ecosystem, including HR, infrastructure, and community. You are not a freelancer. You are a core tea
mber.





ABOUT THE CUSTOMER

Our customer is a US-headquartered Seed startup investing in its infrastructure layer. They are building a product that requires reliable, scalable, and secure systems from day one.



This is a selective process; we are identifying engineers who should be part of the founding technical team.





ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who will own the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability of the platform. You will build and maintain the systems that allow engineers to ship fast and customers to rely on the product.



This is a senior level role where you will have significant ownership over cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and security compliance. Candidates with strong data security and compliance backgrounds are highly preferred.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

-Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on GCP 

-Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable deployments

-Set up and maintain containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

-Build observability infrastructure: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting

-Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools

-Ensure security best practices across infrastructure and deployments

-Support SOC II compliance efforts and work with compliance automation platforms

-Support GDPR and data privacy compliance across infrastructure, including data residency and encryption requirements

-Manage database operations, backups, and disaster recovery

-Optimize for cost, performance, and reliability

-Support developers with tooling, debugging, and environment setup

-Participate in on-call rotations and i
 response



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

-7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering

-Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred, or AWS/Azure

-Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

-Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar)

-Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation)

-Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar)

-Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, or Go)

-Understanding of networking, security, and Linux systems

-Experience with data security, compliance, or regulated environments



Valuable:

-Experience with SOC II audit processes (HUGE advantage)

-Experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms (EVEN BIGGER advantage)

-Experience with GDPR compliance requirements and data residency

-Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, FluxCD)

-Background in managing databases at scale (PostgreSQL, Redis, graph databases)

-Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)

-Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure and workloads

-Previous experience in a startup environment



WHO THRIVES HERE

You believe infrastructure should be invisible to developers: fast, reliable, and self-service. You automate everything you can and document what you cannot. You think about failure modes before they happen. You care about cost as much as performance. You understand that security and compliance are not afterthoughts. You want to build infrastructure that scales with the company.





COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This is a full-time independent contractor engagement, administratively managed by VamosWatu. All Customer Benefits are passed through VamosWatu to you in full. VamosWatu takes no cut.



VamosWatu Ecosystem Benefits:

-15 days of paid time off (PTO) per year

-5 days of paid sick leave per year

-Hallmark holidays off

-0% interest business loans for hardware purchases

-$1,000 per year professional development stipend

-$500 newly married stipend

-$500 new child stipend

-$500 compassionate support for loss of a spouse, child, parent, or sibling

-Cash bonuses for above-and-beyond performance

-Ecosystem-wide recognition for above-and-beyond performance



Customer Benefits:

-Cash bonuses for above-and-beyond performance

-Potential for early-tea
mber equity and shares in the startup



All Customer Benefits are passed through VamosWatu to you in full. VamosWatu takes no cut.







HOW WE WORK

-Your working hours are 09:00 to 18:00 Eastern African Time, Monday through Friday.

-You are expected to work on a compliant device: a MacBook Pro M4 Pro or M5, 24 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, or a Lenovo X1 Carbon, 32 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD or equivalent.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

-At 90 days: CI/CD pipelines are fast and reliable. Infrastructure is documented and reproducible with IaC. Monitoring and alerting are in place. Developers can deploy with confidence.



-At 1 year: Infrastructure scales with the product. Security and compliance posture supports SOC II certification. I
 response is mature. Developer experience is self-service and frictionless.





HIRING PROCESS

1. Submit your application

2. AI interview and coding exercise

3. Live interview with the VamosWatu team

4. Finalists will have a final interview with the customer team



We aim to move quickly and respect your time. Expect to hear from us within 5 business days of applying.

We believe the best teams are built from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We hire for curiosity, craft, and the drive to build, not pedigree. If this role sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for, we want to hear from you.

title: Help Desk Operations Coordinator (MSP) — Dispatch + QA
description:
We're hiring a Help Desk Operations Coordinator to run dispatch for our U.S. help desk and own quality assurance across tickets and phone calls. This is a long-term, full-time role covering U.S. business hours (9am-6pm Pacific Time, Mon-Fri).



You will be the traffic controller of our service delivery operation. Your two primary outcomes:



1. The right ticket is in the right technician's hands at the right time, with no SLA misses.

2. Every ticket and every phone call meets our quality bar, and when it doesn't, the technician gets coached.



What you'll own day to day:



- Ticket triage and dispatch (assign, schedule, and re-balance workload across techs)

- Quality assurance on tickets and phone calls, including remediation and technician coaching

- Onsite scheduling and 3rd-party contractor scheduling (cabling vendors, etc.)

- "Next Ticket" queue management

- "Manage to Zero" board management (keeping the queue clean every day)

- Hyper Care support calls and non-technical customer escalations

- Weekly client call with our largest managed services client

- Inventory receiving and shipping coordination

- Internal academy / LMS administration — keeping content and assignments current

- Running the daily morning huddle with the help desk team

- Backup coverage for new technician onboarding and documentation QA



Must-have experience:



- 2+ years in a dispatch or service coordinator role at an MSP

- Hands-on experience with a PSA ticketing system (ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, or similar — please state which)

- Strong written and verbal English; this role is on camera and on the phone daily

- Calm under pressure, excellent prioritization, obsessive attention to detail

- Comfortable pushing back on technicians and clients professionally



Nice to have:



- Familiarity with an RMM platform

- Experience with call QA scoring / rubric-based coaching

- Familiarity with MSP Bots, BrightGauge, or similar reporting tools

- Exposure to Trainual or a similar LMS/SOP platform

- Prior experience running a morning huddle or standup



To apply — please include all of the following, or your application will be skipped:



1. A short Loom video (5 minutes or less) walking us through this scenario:



"A customer calls in saying their computer was working fine yesterday but now it won't connect to the internet. Walk me through exactly how you would troubleshoot this from start to finish."



How to approach it:

- Pretend you're on a live call with the customer. We want to hear how you think and communicate, not just what you know.

- Walk through your steps in order and speak clearly.

- There's no trick answer. We're looking for your process.



2. A copy of your resume.



3. The name of the PSA you used most recently and roughly how many tickets per day you dispatched.



4. Your current time zone and confirmed availability for 9am-6pm Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.

title: VA For Creative Manager
description:
Type of work: Project Management / E-Commerce Operations Hours: Full-time (~40 hrs/week), starting part-time during the test phase, scaling fast Pay: $1,000–$2,000 / month depending on bonuses, based on skill, speed, and track record Start: As soon as we find the right operator



WHO WE ARE



We're a fast-scaling, profitable Shopify brand (DTC, paid-traffic driven). The owner runs media buying and high-level strategy. We're missing one person: an operator who owns the execution engine so the owner can stay on the levers that scale revenue.



This is not an entry-level VA seat. This is the #2 in the business.



THE ROLE



You take the owner's strategy, research, and AI prompt systems and turn them into finished, ready-to-launch output — fast. You run the people, the deadlines, and the daily machine so nothing slips and the owner never has to chase you.



You will own roughly 80% of daily execution. The owner keeps media buying, money, and expansion strategy.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Creative & Copy (with AI leverage)



Take our copy-planning docs + research and run them through our AI prompt chains to produce finished image-ad concepts, mini sales letters (MSL), and VSL scripts — typically in 20–30 minutes each, not days.

Mine Reddit, Amazon reviews, and customer feedback for new angles and feed the prompt system.

This is NOT a traditional copywriting role. If you refuse to use templates and AI, this isn't for you.



2. Creative & Asset Management



Brief our video editors and graphic designers, hand off approved scripts and image prompts, manage deadlines, QA the output, and deliver upload-ready ads to the owner on a silver platter.



3. Daily Operations & Customer Service



Oversee our customer-support VA (standards, response quality, escalations).

Keep comment sections under our ads clean (protect social proof).

Handle refunds, cancellations, and routine order issues independently.



4. Project Management



Run our task board (Asana). Keep the whole content + ops pipeline moving. Flag blockers early. Own the timeline.

WHO YOU ARE

High executive function — you think and act like a mini-CEO, not a task-taker.

Fast. You'd rather ship a strong v1 today than a perfect v3 next week.

AI-native and comfortable with structured prompt systems and templates.

Organized and reliable — you flag problems early and solve them instead of waiting to be told.

You want a long-term seat where you grow with the business, not a quick gig.

REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience managing or leading other VAs / freelancers (delegate, QA, hold people accountable).

Hands-on experience with Shopify e-commerce operations.

Comfortable writing/editing English ad copy and customer-facing messaging.

Confident with AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) and willing to work inside our prompt frameworks.

Strong with spreadsheets and basic numbers (KPIs, simple margin/reorder math).

Excellent written English.

THE PAID TEST



We only hire people who can actually do the work. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test based on a real scenario from our store: we'll hand you a small copy-planning doc and our MSL/VSL structure, and you'll produce one finished ad concept using AI — on a clock. We're testing execution and speed, not your résumé.



HOW TO APPLY



Read carefully — this is the first part of the test.



Start your message with the word GREENLIGHT and end it with the word SHIP IT. Applications that skip this are deleted unread.

In your application, tell us briefly:

Have you managed other VAs or freelancers before? How many, and what did you own?

Your experience with Shopify operations and/or paid-traffic creative.

Which AI tools you use daily and what you use them for.

How fast you can realistically turn a brief into a finished ad concept.

Include one thing you'd improve about how most e-com brands run their creative pipeline — one sentence, your honest opinion.

If you have examples (ads you've helped ship, ops you've owned), drop a Google Drive link.



We read the quality of thinking in your reply more than the length. Generic copy-paste applications won't make it past the first filter.

title: Media Buyer Needed for E-Commerce Brand (Meta Ads)
description:
# Media Buyer Needed for E-Commerce Brand (Meta Ads)



We're looking for an experienced Media Buyer to help scale our e-commerce brand through paid advertising.



This is not a role for someone who only knows how to launch campaigns. We're specifically looking for a media buyer who understands creative strategy, hooks, customer psychology, audience research, and competitive research.



## Responsibilities



* Manage and optimize Meta 
 & Instagram) ad campaigns

* Analyze campaign performance and identify bottlenecks

* Test audiences, creatives, offers, and campaign structures

* Scale winning campaigns while maintaining profitability

* Provide actionable insights to improve performance

* Work closely with our team on creative direction and ad strategy



## Research Requirements



Before launching campaigns, you must be able to conduct thorough research to understand the market and customer.



This includes:



* Customer research: Identify who is most likely to buy the product, their pain points, desires, objections, and motivations.

* Competitive research: Analyze competitors, their offers, creatives, positioning, and marketing angles.

* Market research: Understand trends, demand, and opportunities within the niche.

* Audience research: Determine which demographics, interests, and behaviors are most likely to convert.



We expect you to be able to look at a product and explain:



* Who buys it

* Why they buy it

* What problem it solves

* What messaging will resonate with potential customers

* What hooks are most likely to grab attention



## What We're Looking For



* Proven experience with e-commerce brands

* Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager

* Ability to analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and other key metrics

* Strong understanding of creative strategy and hooks

* Ability to identify whether performance issues come from the creative, offer, audience, landing page, or campaign setup

* Strong research and analytical skills



If a video ad has a low CTR, we expect you to understand why the hook isn't working and provide recommendations to improve it. We want someone who thinks strategically, not someone who simply launches campaigns and changes budgets.



## To Apply, Please Answer:



1. What e-commerce brands have you worked with?

2. What results have you achieved? (ROAS, revenue generated, CPA improvements)

3. What monthly ad budgets have you managed?

4. Share a campaign you successfully scaled and explain what made it work.

5. What would you do if a video ad had a low CTR?

6. Walk us through your process for customer research and competitive research when starting with a new product.

7. How would you identify the ideal audience for a product you've never marketed before?

8. Please provide screenshots, case studies, or portfolio examples.



We're looking for a media buyer who understands research, strategy, customer psychology, creative testing, and scaling profitable campaigns.

This is an operational leadership role focused on driving field accountability, maintaining elite client satisfaction, and ensuring seamless daily execution of our established security operations.



Key Responsibilities

1. Workforce Logistics & Dispatch Escalations

- Schedule Management: Oversee guard schedules, approve shifts, and manage time-off requests using Humanity software.

- Emergency I
 Direction: Act as the Point of Escalation for our regular Dispatch team. If an urgent field issue arises outside your shift, you will provide critical decisions and direction.

- Roster Quality Control: Monitor guard attendance and performance; handle disciplinary actions and dispute resolutions.



2. Client Account Management & Retention

- Client Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for clients to ensure services meet contract expectations.

- Quality Assurance: Conduct regular operational check-ins with clients to maintain high satisfaction and account retention.



3. System Execution & Data Auditing

- Run Pre-Set Systems: Utilize our tech stack (GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Suite) to pull reports, monitor client alerts, and update site data.

- Time Tracking & Billing Prep: Use QuickBooks Online (QBO) purely to audit guard hours against schedules for accurate client billing preparation.

- Compliance: Manage i
 reports and digital site setups via SilverTrack.



Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in BPO Operations Management, Workforce/Logistics Coordination, or Call Center Team Leadership.

- Experience in the US Security Industry (highly preferred) or high-volume dispatch logistics.

- Strong Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating modern CRMs, scheduling software, and QBO dashboards. You must be an expert at following and enforcing digital SOPs.

- Geographic Familiarity: Strong understanding of (or ability to quickly learn) Southern California geography to accurately guide dispatch decisions.

- Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills—capable of speaking directly with US-based corporate clients.



Work Requirements

- Dedicated, distraction-free home office setup with high-speed backup internet and power source.

- Ability to work fixed US Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours.

- Willingness to be the on-call contact for critical dispatch emergencies outside of regular shift hours.



How to Apply

Send a message with the subject line: TGS Service Coordinator



SALARY: Competitive; Commensurate with qualifications, industry experience, and quality of service.



Include the following:

- A link to your updated resume/CV.

- A link to a 1–2 minute video introduction via Loom or Google Drive (Introduce yourself, highlight your operations/team leader background, and explain how you handle high-pressure logistics decisions).

title: Senior Shopify Growth Manager / E-Commerce Growth Lead

Please see here:

You will report directly to the CEO and be responsible for identifying opportunities, leading execution, improving performance, and making sure our Shopify store, paid media,

Monitor revenue, conversion rate, AOV, returning customer rate, and customer journey performance.

Identify growth opportunities without waiting for the CEO to assign tasks.

Lead experiments around product pages, bundles, upsells, landing pages, checkout flow, offers, and merchandising.

Understand campaign structure deeply: prospecting, retargeting, creative testing, account structure, exclusions, attribution, and offer strategy.

Help translate TikTok creator content into Meta ad creative strategy.

Help select UGC/creator videos that can be licensed and repurposed for Meta ads.

 & SMS Marketing:

Own or heavily lead
/SMS performance.

Understand flows, campaigns, segmentation, deliverability, list growth, A/B testing, and lifecycle marketing.

Improve welcome flows, post-purchase flows, abandoned cart, winback, cross-sell, review request, and promotional campaigns.

Know how
/SMS fits into overall DTC growth.



CRO / UI / UX:

Identify friction points in the customer journey.

Work with developers/designers to improve PDPs, collection pages, landing pages, navigation, cart, checkout, and mobile experience.

Lead conversion testing ideas based on data and customer behavior.



Leadership & Ownership:

Bring ideas, not just updates.

Create weekly priorities and performance summaries.

Lead meetings with media buyers, developers, designers, and TikTok tea
mbers.

Hold people accountable respectfully.

Think like a long-term partner in the business.



What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Experience

3+ years managing or leading growth for Shopify/DTC brands.

Experience with stores doing meaningful revenue, ideally $100k+/month.

Strong understanding of Google Shopping and Merchant Center.

Strong understanding of Meta Ads campaign structure.

Deep experience with
/SMS marketing, ideally Klaviyo or similar.

Strong understanding of CRO, Shopify UX, and landing page optimization.

Comfortable working directly with a CEO.

Excellent written communication.

Self-directed, proactive, and commercially minded.



Nice-to-Have

Experience with TikTok Shop.

Experience repurposing UGC/creator content for paid ads.

Experience with Shopify Plus.

Experience with first aid, health, survival, travel, outdoor, or Amazon-adjacent brands.

Experience managing contractors, agencies, or small internal teams.



---



Who Should NOT Apply:

You are looking for a basic Shopify admin role.

You only upload products, edit pages, or process orders.

You need to be told every task.

You have never looked at paid media performance.

You do not understand Google Shopping, Meta Ads,
/SMS, or CRO.

You cannot explain past results clearly.

You use generic AI answers without real examples.

You are not comfortable being held accountable to revenue and performance.



---



Compensation

$4,000/month USD, full-time. Starting salary, if you show great promise, this of course will increase, we take care of our employees.



We are only looking for premium talent.

---



Application Questions:



Question 1 — Shopify Growth Experience

Tell us about the largest Shopify or DTC brand you have worked on. Include:

Monthly revenue range

Your role

What you personally owned

Specific metrics before/after, if available

 which videos to test, how would you brief the media buyer, and how would you measure success?



Question 5 —
/SMS Marketing

Describe the
 and SMS flows you would expect a $250k/month Shopify store to have. Which flows would you audit first and why?



Question 6 — CRO / UI/UX

Pick one Shopify product page you improved in the past. What was wrong with it, what did you change, and what happened after?



Question 7 — Leadership / Ownership

If you joined and the CEO gave you no tasks for your first week, what would you do? Give a detailed 7-day plan.



Question 8 — Strategic Thinking

Our store is doing $250k/month. What are the first 5 numbers you would want to see every week, and why?



Strong answers should include:

Revenue

Conversion rate

AOV

CAC / blended ROAS / MER

/SMS revenue share

Returning customer rate

Gross margin

Contribution margin

Paid traffic performance by channel

Product-level performance



Question 9 — Attention Check

To show that you read the full job post, start your application with this exact phrase: “I lead growth, not tasks.”

I look forward to hearing from ou.

title: Financial Controller

title: Virtual Assistant Role
description:
VA / Appointment Setter — GoHighLevel + Follow Up Boss (Full-Time, Long-Term, US Hours)



**Salary:** $XXX/month — full-time, Mon–Fri

**Hours:** Must work a FULL US Eastern Time block (8 AM–4 PM or 9 AM–5 PM EST). Night-shift-only applicants will not be considered.

**Start:** Immediately



The Role



I run a marketing agency, a 1-on-1 fitness coaching business, and I support a top real estate agent client. You'll work all three every day from one seat. The job in one sentence: **monitor the CRMs all shift, call every new lead fast, and turn conversations into booked appointments.**



This is an appointment-setter role with operations work around it — not data entry.



## What You'll Do



**Real Estate (Follow Up Boss):**

- Monitor FUB all shift — call/text every new lead same day, work every reply toward an appointment

- Qualify buyers with a provided script, set up property searches, schedule and confirm showings (calling US listing agents)

- Re-engage old leads, send personal touches to past clients, keep every contact on the right campaign

- Post and manage social media content (provided), handle DMs

- Send the agent a short end-of-day list: what needs her, what got booked, what's in motion



**Marketing Agency (GHL + Instantly/Smartlead):**

- Monitor cold
 replies all shift — every reply gets worked same day toward one goal: a booked audit call

- Handle objections from provided scripts; only ever reference our real, documented case studies

- Build prospect lists (Apollo, Google Maps, D7), keep campaigns and inboxes healthy

- Prep website audit research packets (screenshots + notes) so the owner just hits record



**Fitness Coaching (GHL):**

- Call every person who downloads the free guide, same day — qualify with a provided script, sort Hot/Warm/Cold in the pipeline

- Book Hot leads directly on the coach's calendar ON the call

- Protect the show rate: personal day-before texts, call every no-show to rebook

- Work follow-up tasks daily; manage Instagram DMs toward booked consults



Full SOPs, scripts, and pipelines are already built for all three. You execute the system — and tell us when something in it isn't working.



## Requirements



- **GoHighLevel experience required**; **Follow Up Boss experience** (or strong CRM background + master it in week 1)

- Clear, confident **spoken English** — you'll be on the phone with US leads and agents daily

- Excellent **written English** — texting and
ing US clients all day

- Appointment setting experience is a major plus; cold
 tools (Instantly/Smartlead) a plus; real estate VA experience a plus

- Reliable internet + quiet workspace + backup power/internet

- Detail-obsessed: follow the SOP, log everything in the CRM, flag problems instead of hiding them



## Growth Path



- **Months 1–3:** base salary, master the systems, book consistently

- **Month 4+:** commission on every closed deal from an appointment you set (agency + coaching)

- **Later:** first hire becomes Team Supervisor as we add VAs — training, QA, leadership pay + team overrides



## How to Apply (all 6 required — incomplete applications will not be read)



1. Start your application with the word **TRANSCENDENT**

2. Describe your hands-on experience with (a) GoHighLevel and (b) Follow Up Boss — be specific

3. Attach a 1–2 minute voice/video recording (Loom or Vocaroo) introducing yourself in English

4. Your expected monthly salary + which EST block you can commit to (8–4 or 9–5)

5. Scenario 1: A new buyer lead enters the CRM at 9 AM. What exactly do you do in the first 10 minutes?

6. Scenario 2: A cold
 prospect replies "Interesting, but I'm pretty busy right now." Write the exact reply you'd send to get them booked.
