title: VA Shopify Creative Project Manager
description:
Type of work: Project Management / E-Commerce Operations Hours: Full-time (~40 hrs/week), starting part-time during the test phase, scaling fast Pay: $1,000–$2,000 / month depending on bonuses, based on skill, speed, and track record Start: As soon as we find the right operator



WHO WE ARE



We're a fast-scaling, profitable Shopify brand (DTC, paid-traffic driven). The owner runs media buying and high-level strategy. We're missing one person: an operator who owns the execution engine so the owner can stay on the levers that scale revenue.



This is not an entry-level VA seat. This is the #2 in the business.



THE ROLE



You take the owner's strategy, research, and AI prompt systems and turn them into finished, ready-to-launch output — fast. You run the people, the deadlines, and the daily machine so nothing slips and the owner never has to chase you.



You will own roughly 80% of daily execution. The owner keeps media buying, money, and expansion strategy.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Creative & Copy (with AI leverage)



Take our copy-planning docs + research and run them through our AI prompt chains to produce finished image-ad concepts, mini sales letters (MSL), and VSL scripts — typically in 20–30 minutes each, not days.

Mine Reddit, Amazon reviews, and customer feedback for new angles and feed the prompt system.

This is NOT a traditional copywriting role. If you refuse to use templates and AI, this isn't for you.



2. Creative & Asset Management



Brief our video editors and graphic designers, hand off approved scripts and image prompts, manage deadlines, QA the output, and deliver upload-ready ads to the owner on a silver platter.



3. Daily Operations & Customer Service



Oversee our customer-support VA (standards, response quality, escalations).

Keep comment sections under our ads clean (protect social proof).

Handle refunds, cancellations, and routine order issues independently.



4. Project Management



Run our task board (Asana). Keep the whole content + ops pipeline moving. Flag blockers early. Own the timeline.

WHO YOU ARE

High executive function — you think and act like a mini-CEO, not a task-taker.

Fast. You'd rather ship a strong v1 today than a perfect v3 next week.

AI-native and comfortable with structured prompt systems and templates.

Organized and reliable — you flag problems early and solve them instead of waiting to be told.

You want a long-term seat where you grow with the business, not a quick gig.

REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience managing or leading other VAs / freelancers (delegate, QA, hold people accountable).

Hands-on experience with Shopify e-commerce operations.

Comfortable writing/editing English ad copy and customer-facing messaging.

Confident with AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) and willing to work inside our prompt frameworks.

Strong with spreadsheets and basic numbers (KPIs, simple margin/reorder math).

Excellent written English.

THE PAID TEST



We only hire people who can actually do the work. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test based on a real scenario from our store: we'll hand you a small copy-planning doc and our MSL/VSL structure, and you'll produce one finished ad concept using AI — on a clock. We're testing execution and speed, not your résumé.



HOW TO APPLY



Read carefully — this is the first part of the test.



Start your message with the word GREENLIGHT and end it with the word SHIP IT. Applications that skip this are deleted unread.

In your application, tell us briefly:

Have you managed other VAs or freelancers before? How many, and what did you own?

Your experience with Shopify operations and/or paid-traffic creative.

Which AI tools you use daily and what you use them for.

How fast you can realistically turn a brief into a finished ad concept.

Include one thing you'd improve about how most e-com brands run their creative pipeline — one sentence, your honest opinion.

If you have examples (ads you've helped ship, ops you've owned), drop a Google Drive link.



We read the quality of thinking in your reply more than the length. Generic copy-paste applications won't make it past the first filter.

About Us

We're a fast-growing US-based media company offering unique subscription services, cutting-edge entertainment, and a range of consumer products. Comfortable with feedback and iteration

Reliable, communicative, and self-managing

Create compelling, click-worthy visuals aligned with YouTube best practices

Stay current on platform trends, design styles, and audience behavior

Collaborate with our content and video production teams on creative strategy

Maintain brand consistency while exploring fresh design approaches

Iterate based on CTR data and team feedback

You study creators like MrBeast, Ryan Trahan, Alex Hormozi, Diary of a CEO, Cleo Abram, Ali Abdaal, and Colin & Samir. You think constantly about CTR, viewer psychology, packaging, first impressions, and mobile viewing.

title: Remote Solar Engineer

We’re BigBattery, a fast-growing brand focused on providing top-tier battery storage and energy solutions. Whether our customers are building an off-grid cabin, a home backup system, or a full-scale solar array, we help them get the right products, expert guidance, and reliable energy systems. We are seeking a detail-obsessed, fast-moving Solar PV Specialist to own the full technical function of our system configurations. Your mission will be to interpret customer requirements, size custom setups, and validate component compatibility so that every kit is fully optimized for BigBattery products and completely install-ready.

-Solar System Design: Own the full lifecycle of solar design, including load calculations, system sizing, and layout configurations for off-grid and hybrid systems.

-BOM & Compatibility: Build complete, install-ready Bills of Materials (BOMs), ensuring flawless integration between customer inverters, charge controllers, and BigBattery units.

-Technical Support: Act as the company’s technical truth source, providing advanced troubleshooting and integration assistance for customers via
, live chat, or phone.



Requirements



-2–5+ years of hands-on solar PV system design experience, with a heavy emphasis on off-grid or hybrid energy storage setups.

-Deep technical understanding of lithium-ion battery integration, inverters, charge controllers, and proper system wiring/fusing.

-Proficiency with solar design software (such as Aurora Solar, HelioScope, or AutoCAD) and advanced Google Sheets skills for component tracking.

-Fluent written and verbal English communication skills for direct customer interaction and clear documentation.



Schedule & Compensation



-Hours: Full-time (8 hours/day), completely available during 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday.

-Salary: $1,000/month base salary + performance-based output bonuses.

Perks: 5 days of flexible paid time off, fully remote flexibility, and the opportunity to scale with a premier battery brand.



How to Apply

-Step 1: Submit your CV/resume and a past project portfolio showcasing your solar designs (PREFERABLY OFF-GRID WITH LITHIUM BATTERY STORAGE EQUIPMENT).

-Step 2: Complete a short, 10-minute technical evaluation task if shortlisted.

-Step 3: Pass a final video interview with the CTO

title: Part-time AI/SEO & Paid Media Specialist
description:
Our first priority and yours is to increase visibility in AI searches. You must have experience with this. 



US law firm and title company in Florida looking for one specialist to own SEO, AI search visibility, and paid advertising across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn for both brands. Both websites were recently rebuilt with schema markup, keyword targeting, and a solid technical foundation already in place. Your job is to audit what's there, refine it, fill gaps, and build on top of it. Long-term role. Direct work with the firm owner.

Salary

$1,200 to $1,500 USD per month for 15-20 hours per week, based on experience. Paid monthly via Wise or your preferred method. 13th month bonus after first year. Ad spend budget is separate and will be discussed during interview.

Schedule

15-20 hours per week. This position will ultimately become fully async where you can set your own hours. No graveyard shift required, but might be necessary for the first 30-45 days while you are learning the firms and about me. 

The two brands

• Wilkes & Mee, PLLC. Law firm. Personal injury and railroad cases. Website recently rebuilt. Active paid advertising potential on Google Search and Meta.

• Accelerated Title Solutions, LLC. Title company. Florida real estate investors. Website recently rebuilt. Paid potential on Google Search, Meta, and LinkedIn.

What you will own

• Audit and refine existing technical SEO on both websites. Schema (LegalService, Attorney, FAQ, LocalBusiness) and on-page work are already in place. You tune what's there, expand into gaps, and keep it sharp as content grows.

• Your main project will be to work on AI search visibility: structure pages for citation by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews; build out entity presence (Knowledge Panel, Wikidata when appropriate, directory consistency)

• Keyword research and a quarterly keyword and topic plan that feeds our content coordinator

• Google Ads campaigns for both brands: setup, audience research, negative keyword discipline, ongoing optimization

• Meta paid ads for both brands

• LinkedIn paid ads for Accelerated Title Solutions

• Attribution and lead-quality tracking (we use CallRail)

• Hand keyword and topic priorities to our Social & Content Coordinator each week so they can write content around what actually moves traffic

Reporting (non-negotiable)

Every Friday you send Alisa a weekly report. The report includes:

• Keyword ranking changes (gains, drops, new rankings)

• AI visibility wins (citations or mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)

• Ad spend by campaign, cost per lead, lead quality notes from CallRail

• Schema or technical SEO work completed, with before and after

• Keyword and topic priorities for the Social & Content Coordinator next week

• What is working, what is not, and your honest read

If you cannot commit to a weekly report with real numbers, this is not the role for you.

Requirements

• 3+ years doing technical SEO for US businesses

• 2+ years actively managing Google Ads campaigns with budget responsibility

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager (and ideally LinkedIn Campaign Manager)

• Working understanding of 
 and how to implement structured data

• You MUST have an understanding of how LLMs surface and cite businesses (entity SEO, prompt-aware content)

• Comfortable with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and at least one keyword tool (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar)

• Strong written English for ad copy and client reporting

• Self-managing. You can run a full week of work from a Loom video and a Slack channel.

Nice to have

• SEO or paid media experience for a US law firm, real estate, or other regulated industry (our advertising for Wilkes & Mee is regulated by the Florida & Georgia Bar). 

• CallRail or call-tracking attribution experience

• Local SEO experience (Google Business Profile, citations)

To apply, send the following

• Short note (not a cover letter) on why this role interests you

• Two or three case studies showing a measurable SEO or paid ads result you personally delivered (rankings, traffic, leads, cost per acquisition). Include numbers.

• One or two sample weekly or monthly client reports you have sent in a past role, with any client info redacted. Required. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

• Your current preferred tool stack (keyword research, rank tracking, schema, reporting)

• Your requested rate for 15-20 hours per week

Please do not apply if

• You have never personally pushed live to a Google Ads account

• You are an agency reselling someone else's work. We hire the person doing the work.

• You do not use AI tools yourself

• You are looking for a short-term project. This is a long-term role.

- The five main tabs: Home, Workouts, Nutrition, AI Coach chat, Profile

Our brand is calm, clean, and modern. Think confident and minimal, not loud fitness hype. We will share brand references, but we want a designer who can elevate this, not just follow a template.

title: Social Media Manager for Instagram, TikTok, & Pinterest
description:
# Social Media Content Creator + Video Editor



## Luxury Bridal Alterations & Customization Atelier



**Brand:** Mrs. P Stitches Bridal

**Location:** Toronto, Canada

**Website:** 

**Instagram:** 



---



## About Mrs. P Stitches Bridal



Mrs. P Stitches is a boutique bridal alterations and customization atelier based in Toronto. We specialize in bridal gown alterations, customizations, and transformations that help each bride feel confident, beautiful, and completely herself on her wedding day.



We are not a traditional alterations shop. We are a bridal experience brand rooted in craftsmanship, care, emotion, and refinement.



Every gown we work on has a story. It may be a modern designer dress, a sentimental heirloom, a vintage gown, or a custom transformation created to reflect the bride’s personal vision. Our content should capture that feeling with elegance and intention.



We are looking for a creative partner who can help us bring these 
nts to life through premium, story-driven short-form content.



---



## Role Overview



We are looking for a high-taste **Social Media Content Creator + Video Editor** to help us build a refined, emotional, and visually elevated presence across Instagram and TikTok.



This is not a basic editing role.



We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, luxury branding, and how to turn raw behind-the-scenes footage into content that feels polished, meaningful, and engaging.



You will work with raw footage filmed by our team, including bridal fittings, seamstress work, gown transformations, detail shots, and behind-the-scenes atelier 
nts. Your role will be to shape that footage into Reels and TikToks that reflect the care, craftsmanship, and emotional experience behind our brand.



---



## What You’ll Be Creating



You will help create short-form content such as:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok videos

* Short-form video variations

* Hook and caption ideas

* Text overlay direction

* Occasional carousel or post concept ideas

* Repurposed clips for different platforms



Content may include:



* Bridal fittings

* Before-and-after gown transformations

* Bustle work

* Seamstress craftsmanship

* Educational bridal alteration 
nts

* Bride and family reactions

* Vintage or sentimental gown stories

* Behind-the-scenes atelier content



---



## What This Role Is Really About



We are not looking for someone who simply edits clips together.



We are looking for someone who can find the story inside the footage.



The right person will understand how to take a quiet fitting 
nt, a detailed seamstress adjustment, or a gown transformation and turn it into content that feels elevated, emotional, and aligned with a luxury bridal audience.



Our ideal content should feel:



* Elegant

* Warm

* Refined

* Emotional

* Trustworthy

* Detail-oriented

* Premium, but not overly staged

* Beautiful, but still authentic



Luxury does not need to feel loud or overly trendy. For us, luxury means intention, care, and a strong sense of detail.



---



## Responsibilities



### Video Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok

* Cut raw footage into polished, structured content

* Remove filler words, slow 
nts, and unnecessary footage

* Add subtitles, text overlays, music, and clean transitions where needed

* Create videos with strong pacing and visual flow

* Adapt edits for Instagram and TikTok where needed



### Storytelling & Strategy



* Build videos with a clear hook, flow, and ending

* Identify the strongest 
nts in raw footage

* Create content that holds attention without feeling clickbait

* Suggest content angles based on the footage provided

* Repurpose one piece of footage into multiple content variations

* Help shape a consistent content style for the brand



### Brand Alignment



* Maintain a polished, luxury bridal aesthetic

* Ensure content feels consistent across our social media platforms

* Protect the warm, elegant, and professional tone of the brand

* Highlight the craftsmanship, care, and emotion behind our work

* Bring creative input while respecting final brand approval



### Workflow



* Work with content stored in Google Drive and Notion

* Follow a weekly or monthly batch workflow

* Submit content for review and feedback

* Make revisions when needed

* Collaborate with our team on creative direction and improvements



---



## What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for detail, beauty, and emotion. You understand that bridal content is not just about showing a dress — it is about telling the story of the bride, the gown, and the transformation.



### Must-Haves



* Strong portfolio of Instagram Reels and/or TikTok edits

* Experience editing short-form video content

* Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention

* Clean, intentional editing style

* Ability to create premium-looking content without relying heavily on templates

* Strong sense of aesthetics and storytelling

* Ability to turn raw footage into structured, engaging videos

* Ability to explain your creative decisions

* Reliable communication and organized workflow



### Nice-to-Haves



* Experience with bridal, fashion, beauty, or luxury brands

* Experience with service-based businesses

* Understanding of TikTok and Instagram content behavior

* Experience creating educational or behind-the-scenes content

* Ability to suggest captions, text overlays, and content angles



---



## Package-Based Pricing



We are looking for someone who offers **set package options**, rather than hourly pricing.



Please include your package options in your application, such as:



* Monthly package pricing

* Number of Reels/TikToks included

* What is included in each package

* Turnaround time

* Number of revisions included

* Whether captions, hooks, text overlays, or audio direction are included

* Whether content strategy or content planning is included

* Any add-on options available



We are interested in finding a package that supports consistent, high-quality content creation on an ongoing basis.



---



## Test Task



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short paid trial task so we can understand your editing style, taste level, and creative thinking.



The test may include creating two short Reels using raw footage provided by our team.



We will be reviewing:



* Editing quality

* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Hook strength

* Clip selection

* Brand alignment

* Caption/text overlay direction

* Creative thought process



Along with the completed Reels, we may ask you to provide a brief explanation of your creative direction and why you edited the videos the way you did.



We are looking for taste, thoughtfulness, and structure — not just technical editing.



---



## Screening Questions



Please answer the following when applying:



1. Please share 2–3 examples of your best short-form video edits.

2. What package options do you offer for ongoing short-form content creation?

3. What is included in each package?

4. How do you approach turning raw footage into engaging content?

5. What makes a video feel premium rather than generic?

6. How do you d
 what the hook of a video should be?

7. Do you have experience with bridal, fashion, beauty, luxury, or service-based brands?

8. What is your typical turnaround time for Reels/TikToks?



---



## Success in This Role Looks Like



You will be successful in this role if:



* Our content feels more intentional, polished, and consistent

* Reels and TikToks have stronger hooks, pacing, and retention

* Raw footage is transformed into multiple usable content assets

* The brand develops a recognizable visual and storytelling identity

* Behind-the-scenes 
nts feel elevated and meaningful

* Brides can feel the care, craftsmanship, and emotion behind our work

* Content supports Mrs. P Stitches as a premium bridal alterations and customization atelier



---



## This Role Is Not a Fit If You



* Rely heavily on templates

* Edit without thinking about story, emotion, or brand positioning

* Prefer fast volume over quality

* Create content that feels generic or overly trendy

* Need every creative decision explained step by step

* Do not understand luxury, bridal, or high-touch service positioning

* Only want to execute tasks without offering creative input



---



## Our Goal



We are looking for a long-term creative partner to help us build a premium, emotionally driven social media presence.



Someone who can help Mrs. P Stitches become known not only for bridal alterations, but for the artistry, care, transformation, and meaning behind every gown.



This role is for someone who understands that luxury bridal content should feel more than beautiful.



It should feel intentional, personal, and unforgettable.

title: PPC Manager (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
We are a U.S.-based digital marketing agency looking for an experienced PPC Manager to manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta 
/Instagram).



This is a full-time remote position (40 hours per week) for someone who is highly analytical, results-driven, and capable of managing campaigns across multiple industries. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, optimization, reporting, and driving measurable business results for our clients.



Hours



* Full-time (40 hours per week)

Flexible Schedule as long as we are aware of regular schedule



Responsibilities



* Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta advertising campaigns

* Conduct keyword, competitor, and audience research

* Develop campaign strategies tailored to each client's goals

* Write and test ad copy and provide creative direction

* Manage budgets, bidding strategies, and account structure

* Monitor and improve key performance metrics including CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates

* Ensure accurate conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and related platforms

* Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities for growth

* Manage accounts across a variety of industries including:



  * Automotive dealerships

  * Home service businesses

  * Restaurants

  * Events and entertainment

  * Local businesses

  * Ecommerce brands

  * Other lead generation and service-based industries



Expected Weekly & Monthly Deliverables



* Ongoing campaign optimizations and account maintenance

* Ad copy and creative testing

* Budget pacing and bid adjustments

* Conversion tracking audits and monitoring

* Weekly communication regarding campaign updates and performance, weekly strategy call to go through accounts

* Monthly reporting with insights, recommendations, and strategic direction



Required Experience & Skills



* 3–5+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads

* Proven campaign success with examples of CPL, CPA, ROAS, lead generation, or revenue growth

* Strong understanding of:



  * Google Ads

  * Meta Ads

  * Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

  * Google Tag Manager (GTM)

  * Conversion tracking and attribution

  * Landing page optimization principles

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and campaigns simultaneously

* Strong ad copywriting and testing experience



What We're Looking For



* Data-driven and results-oriented

* Reliable and accountable

* Excellent communication skills

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Able to manage campaigns independently with minimal oversight

* Comfortable working across multiple industries and adapting strategies based on business type and objectives



To Apply, Please Include



* Examples of campaigns you have managed

* Industries you have experience working with

* Performance results (CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversions, revenue generated, etc.)

* Your availability and preferred compensation structure



Compensation



Monthly retainer based on experience and qualifications.

title: Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper – QuickBooks, AP/AR, Invoicing & Data Entry
description:
We are hiring a full-time remote Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper / Accounting Assistant to join our growing back-office accounting team. This is a long-term role for a detail-oriented accounting professional with strong QuickBooks Desktop / QuickBooks Enterprise experience who enjoys hands-on bookkeeping, data entry, and Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable work.



You will perform daily data entry into our financial ERP systems (Fishbowl Inventory Advanced, QuickBooks Enterprise, and Asana), audit transactions for accuracy, process AP and AR transactions, and handle other day-to-day administrative accounting and back-office support functions.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



- Post cash receipts and record daily financial transactions.

- Invoice customers and follow up on outstanding balances to collect payments.

- Enter customer purchase orders into our ERP / financial systems.

- Process Accounts Receivable transactions, including customer credit card, ACH, and wire transfer payments.

- Review vendor bills and purchase orders for accuracy and proper coding.

- Assist with bank reconciliations and general ledger account reconciliations.

- Provide administrative backup and support to the sales team as needed.

- Perform other bookkeeping, accounting, financial, and administrative tasks as required.



REQUIREMENTS



- College degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance, or equivalent.

- Prior experience in an accounting department, bookkeeping role, or other financial/back-office position.

- 3+ years of advanced, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Desktop / QuickBooks Enterprise.

- Strong skills handling financial and numeric data with a high degree of accuracy.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.

- Ability to maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive financial information.

- Highly organized, persistent, and detail-oriented.

- Strong critical thinking, multitasking, prioritization, and time management skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English for clear communication with our US-based team.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet home-office setup.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with Fishbowl Inventory or other inventory/ERP systems.

- Experience using Asana or similar project management tools.

- Background supporting a US-based company, e-commerce business, or consumer products manufacturer.



ABOUT US



Accessory Power is a US-based consumer electronics manufacturer that has been providing high-quality products for over 30 years. We design, manufacture, and market thousands of products under our four main brands — GOgroove, ENHANCE, ReVIVE, and USA Gear — along with several other product lines and accessory categories. We are growing quickly and need your help to keep our accounting operations running smoothly.



Learn more about our company at: 
/about



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your accounting background.

2. Your years of experience with QuickBooks Desktop / Enterprise and any other ERP systems you have used.

3. Your expected monthly salary (in USD or PHP).

4. Your available start date and number of hours per week you can commit.

5. An updated résumé or CV.



We look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Full-Stack SaaS Developer with Chrome Extension Experience
description:
We are looking for a skilled **Full-Stack Developer** to help us build a SaaS tool for marketplace sellers and brands.



The tool will analyze product listings on marketplaces like OTTO, find SEO and content optimization opportunities, and use AI to generate better product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and keyword suggestions.



This is a remote position. We are looking for someone who can work independently, think product-focused, and help us build a working MVP from scratch.



## Main Responsibilities



* Build a Chrome Extension using Manifest V3

* Extract product listing data from marketplace pages using DOM scraping

* Build a SaaS dashboard for users, products, analyses, and AI suggestions

* Create backend APIs for data processing, user management, and AI features

* Integrate OpenAI API or similar AI/LLM APIs

* Set up and manage the database structure for users, products, keywords, and analyses

* Build simple scoring logic for product listings

* Prepare the technical foundation for future features like rank tracking, competitor analysis, and Stripe subscriptions

* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code



## Required Skills



You should have experience with:



* JavaScript / TypeScript

* React / Next.js

* Node.js or Python / FastAPI

* Chrome Extensions, ideally Manifest V3

* PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, or similar databases

* API integrations

* OpenAI API or other AI/LLM tools

* Web scraping, DOM parsing, or browser automation

* Git and basic deployment workflows



## Nice to Have



* Playwright or Puppeteer experience

* SaaS product development experience

* Stripe integration experience

* Experience with SEO tools, eCommerce, marketplaces, Amazon, OTTO, Shopify, or product listing optimization

* Experience building dashboards or internal tools



## What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only waits for exact tasks.



We are looking for a developer who can:



* Work independently

* Ask smart questions

* Suggest better technical solutions

* Think in terms of MVP and product value

* Communicate clearly

* Solve problems without overcomplicating the system

* Take ownership of the technical implementation



## Project Scope



The first goal is to build an MVP with:



1. User login

2. Chrome Extension

3. Product listing data extraction

4. AI-based listing analysis

5. AI-generated title, bullet point, description, and keyword suggestions

6. Dashboard to save, view, and manage analyzed products

7. Export or copy function for optimized content



If the MVP works well, this can become a long-term role.



## Work Setup



* Remote work

* Part-time or full-time possible

* Long-term collaboration preferred

* Flexible working hours, but reliable communication is required

* Weekly progress updates required



## To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you built a Chrome Extension before? Please share examples.

2. Have you built a SaaS dashboard before? Please share examples.

3. What is your strongest tech stack?

4. Do you have experience with OpenAI API or other AI APIs?

5. Do you have experience with scraping, DOM parsing, Playwright, or Puppeteer?

6. How would you build the first MVP for this project?

7. What is your expected monthly salary for part-time and full-time work?

8. When could you start?

9. Please share your GitHub, portfolio, or relevant project links.



Please start your application with the word **MARKETPLACE AI**, so we know you read the full job post.

About Inquivix

Inquivix is a Seoul-based digital marketing agency. We help international companies enter the Korean market through Naver SEO, Kakao advertising, paid media, social media, and web development.



We are a small, fully remote, AI-forward agency. AI is not a nice-to-have here — it is how we work. We use AI across every function: content production, reporting, campaign analysis, process automation, and client delivery. If you think in systems, build workflows, and use AI tools to solve real business problems — not just generate text — this role is for you.



The Role

This is a marketing execution role for someone with a technical mindset. You do not need to be a developer (though dev background is welcome). You need to be someone who thinks about how to make processes faster, more consistent, and more scalable — using AI tools and structured thinking.



You will produce marketing deliverables (content, ads, reports, campaign materials) for our clients, with a focus on finding and implementing better ways to do things using AI.



What you will do:

- Produce client deliverables using AI tools: blog posts, ad copy, campaign materials, reports, content briefs, influencer guidelines

- Identify opportunities to improve production workflows using AI — faster content, better reporting, more consistent output

- Build and maintain AI-assisted production workflows: prompts, templates, review checklists, automation sequences

- Work with campaign data: pulling CSVs, processing data through AI tools, producing formatted outputs

- Propose automation ideas to your PM with documented reasoning: what process, what tool, what risk, what review step

- Maintain quality standards — AI output is never final. You review, verify, and refine everything before submission.





Requirements:

- Strong AI tool proficiency — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools daily for real production work, not experimentation

- Systems thinking — you see a manual process and immediately think about how to make it faster, more reliable, or more consistent

- Comfortable with data — CSVs, spreadsheets, data exports. You do not need to be an analyst, but you need to be comfortable handling structured data.

- Strong written English

- Self-directed — you find problems and propose solutions without being asked

- Honest about AI limitations — you know that LLMs hallucinate, you know AI output needs human review, and you build that review step into everything you do



Strong Advantage (Not Required — But Will Set You Apart):

- Developer background (any language) — even basic scripting, web development, or automation experience is valuable

- Experience building AI prompts, prompt chains, or AI-assisted workflows for business use

- Experience with APIs, no-code tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), or automation platforms

- Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, or Naver platform

- Experience at a digital marketing agency

- Basic Korean language ability



This role is NOT a good fit if you:

- Use AI only for basic text generation ("write me an
 about X")

- Are not comfortable working with data or spreadsheets

- Prefer to wait for instructions rather than find problems to solve

- Build things without thinking about quality control, review steps, or error handling

title: Influencer Research & Outreach VA (NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED)
description:
TURN YOUR SOCIAL MEDIA SCROLLING INTO A REMOTE JOB (Influencer Research + DM VA)

If you spend way too much time on Instagram/TikTok checking gym creators, this might be the easiest job you ever land.



We’re a Gen-Z–run app studio building a fast-growing fitness app, and we’re hiring VAs to help us research, reach out to, and build relationships with influencers.



- No experience required.

- No resume required.

- Just strong English + good judgment + social media instincts.

- Must work NYC timezones! (in between 9am to 5pm)



If you understand gym culture, talk like a human, and type like a native English speaker, you’re already ahead of 99% of applicants.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

This role is part lead generation, part DM outreach, part relationship management.



Your daily tasks:

- Find new fitness creators (gym/lifting niche only)

- Add them to our Google Sheet with the correct info (username, followers, country,
, etc.)

- Evaluate their profile quality (are they legit, on-brand, and worth reaching out to?)

- DM influencers using our scripts

- Handle the conversation in a friendly, natural, professional way

- Answer questions, keep the convo alive, and push creators toward collaboration

- Follow up consistently

- Track responses and organize leads properly



You’ll basically be the person discovering new influencers and bringing them into the brand.

We’ll teach you everything; you just need strong English and social media instincts.





YOU’RE A FIT IF YOU

- Have very strong written English (this is the #1 requirement)

- Can communicate clearly and confidently

- Know the gym/fitness niche (huge bonus)

- Are organized and detail-oriented

- Can follow instructions EXACTLY

- Are comfortable reaching out to people on social media

- Have good judgment (can spot fake/farm accounts instantly)

- Are under 28 (our team is young)

- Want part-time remote work you can do from anywhere



We don’t care about degrees. We care about output, consistency, and attitude.





WHAT WE OFFER

- Remote work

- Fast replies, fast onboarding

- Fun Gen-Z team

- Simple tasks anyone smart can do

- Performance-based promotions

- The chance to handle creator deals + negotiations once you prove yourself





QUESTIONNAIRE part 1 (WHEN APPLIYING) — Influencer Sheet Review + Research



Use this Google Sheet template (make a copy of the sheet to modify it): 
/drive/folders/1hDVQyxHEi-ZmaKfmGk1KWSzqrxKSM-Q7?usp=sharing



You must complete:

Rows 3–13 — Note the leads as PASS or FAIL



Look at the creators already listed and ONLY fill the PASS / FAIL column (1st column of the table).

Base your decision on:

- Fitness/gym relevance (are they a gym influencer?)

- Their country (our target audience is North American countries and 1st world countries)

- High number of views (100 000 median views minimum)

*Little tip, less than 50% are good :)*



Rows 14–23 — Add your favorite 10 Fitness Creators (based on the same criterias that were used for rows 3-13)

Add:

- Username

- Instagram profile link

- Number of followers

- Median views per reel (approximately)

- Full name

-
 (if public)

- Country



These must be real gym/lifting creators. No deep digging. Just fast and accurate, we already have these infos on 99% of the industry, we just want to see if you understand simple, straightforward instructions!





QUESTIONNAIRE part 2 (AFTER YOU GOT SELECTED FOR THE 2ND ROUND) — 1-3 Minutes Introduction Video



Record a simple phone video (no editing needed) and answer:

- Who you are

- Any experience with customer support jobs, social media or research

- How comfortable you are chatting with influencers through DMs

- Why you’re a good fit for this role



Just speak clearly and naturally.





HOW TO APPLY

Reply to this job post with:

A Google Drive link containing:

- Your completed Google Sheet (for QUESTIONNAIRE part 1 tasks)



Answers to these short questions (in text form in the message you send when applying):

- How many hours/day or week can you work?

- Are you comfortable with NYC TIME hours full-time?

- Are you comfortable handling DM conversations?



Applications missing either QUESTIONNAIRE part 1 OR answers to the questions will be ignored automatically.
